title: Tic-Tac-Toe with Discs
description: Mixed-media collage featuring a tic-tac-toe grid constructed from blue and red ribbon stripes on an ivory ground, with X markers formed from crossed dark sticks and heart-shaped O pieces in red and orange. Compact discs are embedded within the grid and clustered densely across the lower portion, interspersed with multicolored ribbon fragments.
